# Turing Change Point Dataset

Authoritative source record for the benchmark datasets used by `cpd-stress-test`.

- Publisher/repository: The Alan Turing Institute
- Repository: https://github.com/alan-turing-institute/TCPD
- Code licence: MIT
- Data licensing: dataset-specific

The repository README explicitly distinguishes code licensing from data licensing: the code is MIT-licensed, while individual data files often have their own licences and some series cannot be redistributed because of licensing restrictions.

For that reason this registry does **not** assign MIT to the dataset collection as a whole.

The consuming project may retain small cached JSON files for offline benchmarking only when their individual source/licence terms permit it. The upstream repository remains the authoritative source for provenance and per-series metadata.
